+func I64toa(buf []byte, v int64) ([]byte) {
+	// Ensure there is enough capacity for the native conversion (up to 32 bytes)
+	// and reserve guard bytes required by the native implementation.
+	buf = rt.GuardSlice2(buf, 32)

+

+	if ret > 0 {
+		return buf[:len(buf)+ret]
+	}
